Formations, densités et vitesses soniqu: Formations, densities and sonic velocities of the layers; vertical stress = mean density of the layers above; hydrostatic pore pressure (1.00 sg) plus an overpressure zone generated by this mini-game, since the engine has none; fracture by Eaton's law, Pf = Pp + ν/(1−ν) × (σv − Pp) with ν = 0.35; rock strength UCS = 1277 × exp(−0.036 × Δt) (McNally correlation), bounded from 15 to 300 MPa.
Règles de jeu simplifiées, pas de la phy: Simplified game rules, not exact physics.
Avancement = 14 m/h × (poids/100)^0,8 ×: Rate of penetration = 14 m/h × (weight/100)^0.8 × (rotation/120)^0.6 × (50/UCS)^0.7, reduced by wear and, beyond 0.04 sg of mud overbalance, by 3 % per additional hundredth of sg (cuttings hold-down effect). Tool wear = 0.0005 per metre × (UCS/50)^0.6 × (rotation/120)^0.9 × (weight/100)^0.7. Minimum cleaning flow rate = 1100 + 22 × rate of penetration (L/min). Kick: the pit gains as long as pore pressure exceeds the mud, blowout beyond 6 m³. Losses: the mud exceeds the open-hole fracture pressure. Differential sticking: tool stationary 3 steps or more opposite a permeable layer with more than 0.12 sg of overbalance.
Le GR de chaque couche suit les lois de: Each layer's GR follows the game's log laws (clay 115 API, clean rock low depending on its clay share, evaporites and basement fixed), plus noise of ±8 API. The planned tops differ from the real tops by about 3 % of the depth (60 m at most). The stop is decided by the player: tolerance of 60 m below the real reservoir top, forced stop at 150 m.
La densité demandée n'atteint le fond q: The requested density only reaches the bottom after a bottoms-up, i.e. 0.4 h + depth / 1800 × 1500 / flow rate. This is why you have to anticipate the pressure ramp, not follow it.
